# Qarinah

> Your project remembers, even when your coding agent changes.

Qarinah keeps one compact, cited project memory beside your code, so Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and compatible tools can continue from verified context instead of starting from zero.

This file is a convenience map for tools that choose to read it. It is not a ranking signal or a substitute for the canonical documentation.

## Start here

- [Homepage](https://qarinah.io/): Product overview, benchmark summary, and primary navigation.
- [Verified cross-agent handoffs](https://qarinah.io/docs/cross-agent-handoffs/): Switch coding agents and continue a real task with compact, cited project context.
- [Direct answers](https://qarinah.io/docs/faq/): Concise answers about Qarinah, context reduction, cost boundaries, Codex, Claude Code, privacy, and open-source licensing.
- [Qarinah alternatives](https://qarinah.io/alternatives/): Product-boundary comparison with Mem0, Letta, LangMem, LangGraph memory, Graphiti, Zep, and native coding-host memory.
- [Open-source governed-agent toolkit](https://qarinah.io/articles/open-source-governed-agent-toolkit/): How Qarinah, Maqam, Cockroach Browser, and Cockroach Crawler can compose with established agent, browser, web-data, and document tools.
- [Getting started](https://qarinah.io/docs/getting-started/): Install Qarinah, opt in one workspace, connect a supported host, and compile a cited context pack.
- [Documentation index](https://qarinah.io/docs/): Documentation by task.
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/qarinah): Published `qarinah` package and registry metadata.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/AjnasNB/qarinah): Source, releases, issues, and contribution history.

## Direct facts

- Qarinah is a universal context engine for software projects and an independent local tool; Maqam is an optional governance integration.
- Qarinah is a local, evidence-linked project-memory compiler for coding agents. It is not a complete autonomous-agent runtime or a general personalization service.
- The alternatives guide is a representative category comparison, not a performance ranking or a claim that Qarinah is universally better than adjacent products.
- Qarinah, Maqam, Cockroach Browser, and Cockroach Crawler are separate projects by Ajnas N B. The ecosystem guide distinguishes them from third-party tools maintained by their own projects.
- Cockroach Browser uses Playwright. Cockroach Crawler discloses Trafilatura as the optional quality dependency. The ecosystem guide does not claim that those established projects were created by Qarinah's author.
- Qarinah's primary workflow is verified handoffs between coding agents.
- Qarinah supports reviewed Codex and Claude Code integrations that can use the same explicitly opted-in project record.
- The published evaluator measured 98.71% less estimated repeated input context in its compared task set: 442,113 estimated input-context tokens became 5,682 while every required target was directly covered in the top five.
- The 98.71% result is not a universal provider-billing, latency, or answer-quality guarantee. Qarinah improves provenance and inspectability but cannot guarantee a model answer is correct.
- Qarinah requires no hosted memory account, embedding API, vector database, or Qarinah API key for local operation.
- Qarinah is open source under Apache License 2.0.

## Technical documentation

- [CLI reference](https://qarinah.io/docs/cli/): Every command, option, stdin mode, exit code, and machine-readable output.
- [JavaScript API reference](https://qarinah.io/docs/api/): Public exports, types, functions, and bounded programmatic workflows.
- [Host integrations](https://qarinah.io/docs/integrations/): Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, CLI, and consent-gated MCP integration guidance.
- [MCP guide](https://qarinah.io/docs/mcp/): Configure diagnostic-only or explicitly authorized, zero-write context retrieval.
- [Local memory dashboard](https://qarinah.io/docs/dashboard/): Generate and interpret the read-only project view for decisions, conflicts, citations, activity, affected files, and caller-measured context savings.
- [Team memory](https://qarinah.io/docs/team-memory/): Setup, dashboards, freshness, multi-repository packs, encrypted sync, evaluation, and causal receipts.
- [Token-efficient context](https://qarinah.io/docs/token-efficient-context/): How Qarinah selects compact evidence without making the complete transcript the prompt.
- [Task recipes](https://qarinah.io/docs/recipes/): Copyable workflows for refactors, debugging, migrations, research, releases, and handoffs.
- [Architecture](https://qarinah.io/docs/architecture/): Append-only event record, deterministic derived state, typed graph, retrieval, and context-pack compilation.
- [Benchmarks](https://qarinah.io/docs/benchmarks/): Reproducible methodology, qualifications, commands, and committed results.
- [Security model](https://qarinah.io/docs/security/): Workspace trust, capture consent, redaction, integrity, disclosure boundaries, and known limits.
- [Interoperability](https://qarinah.io/docs/interoperability/): Deterministic Markdown, JSON, graph, and Google Open Knowledge Format exports.
- [Troubleshooting](https://qarinah.io/docs/troubleshooting/): Diagnose trust, capture, rebuild, query, MCP, and host-integration failures.
- [FAQ](https://qarinah.io/docs/faq/): Direct answers about storage, privacy, context reduction, hosts, and operating boundaries.
- [Migration guide](https://qarinah.io/docs/migrations/): Upgrade persisted Qarinah workspaces safely.
- [Technical white paper](https://qarinah.io/paper/): Published implementation-backed paper version 1.4 for Qarinah 0.1.6; version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21850747 and persistent paper-series DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21547684.

## Publication and support

- [Published white-paper v1.4](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21850747): Immutable Zenodo publication and version DOI; the website PDF is byte-identical.
- [Published white-paper v1.3](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21843240): Immutable prior publication and version DOI.
- [DOI record](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21547684): Persistent concept DOI resolving to the latest Zenodo version.
- [Support](https://github.com/AjnasNB/qarinah/blob/main/SUPPORT.md): Usage questions, defects, feature requests, and private security-reporting guidance.
- [Security policy](https://github.com/AjnasNB/qarinah/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Vulnerability-reporting policy.
